beaconsoftware-beaconsoftware:ashbyhq:a0.title: Recruiting Operations Lead
beaconsoftware-beaconsoftware:ashbyhq:a0.description: ABOUT THE ROLE Beacon's talent function is scaling fast, running in parallel across corporate functions and a growing roster of independently operated portfolio companies. Supporting each one of those searches are the systems and processes behind it: clean Ashby data, funnel and data reporting, and coordination that doesn't drop a candidate between steps. We're looking for a Recruiting Operations Lead to own that infrastructure end-to-end, and to build it right the first time, rather than retrofit in the future. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING - Own Ashby. Configuration, workflows, integrations, and data hygiene are yours end-to-end, not a shared responsibility with whoever has time. - Build the reporting layer. Funnel metrics, time-to-fill, source effectiveness, and hiring velocity, dashboards recruiters, executives, GMs, and hiring leadership use to make decisions. - Process design. Turn how Beacon hires today into documented, repeatable workflows that hold up as the team and portfolio grow. - Coordination backbone. Partner closely with our Recruiting Coordinator to keep scheduling, candidate communications, and interview logistics clean, especially with multiple portco searches running at once. - AI & automation. Identify and deploy tooling that reduces admin burden across candidate screening and scheduling. This might branch out to other areas including sourcing, and post interview decisions and offer workflows. - Candidate experience. Standardize the candidate journey across corporate and portco searches with a consistently high bar. - Cross-functional glue. Work with VP of Talent and Finance on headcount planning and with legal/People partners on offer letters, background checks, and clean handoffs. - Data hygiene at holdco scale. Every portfolio company's reqs, candidates, and hires need to roll up cleanly into one picture. You build that structure now, not after it's already messy. WHAT YOU BRING - 5+ years in recruiting operations, HR technology, or business systems administration, with real ownership of an ATS (Ashby strongly preferred). - Comfort building process from scratch, not optimizing an existing one. Beacon's talent function is new; you'll be writing the manual, not editing it. - A strong analytical mindset. You can build a dashboard, but more importantly, you know which metric actually changes a decision. - Systems thinking. You can map how a change in one workflow ripples through downstream reporting and integrations before you make it. - Comfort with ambiguity in a fast-moving, small-team, multi-entity environment. No two portfolio companies operate the same way. - Excellent cross-functional communication; you'll work directly with the Talent, Department Heads/Managers, Finance, and People partners across a holding company structure. - Bachelor's degree, or additional years of experience in lieu. BONUS POINTS - Experience in a PE-backed or multi-entity/holdco environment, where recruiting ops had to serve several operationally independent businesses at once. - Experience standing up recruiting ops and systems from scratch (0-to-1), not just optimizing a mature function. - Experience partnering with a lean recruiting coordination function to keep logistics tight without a large ops team behind you. Our Values at Beacon Software - Humility: We acknowledge that the path to getting to the right answer involves being wrong along the way. We have strong beliefs which are weakly held. We actively seek new ideas and believe we can learn from anyone at any time. - Honesty: We are truth seeking in our approach to business problems. Business is a repeat game and we believe that human relationships generate alpha. We understand that trust is earned over a lifetime and can be lost in an instant. - Hunger: We play to win. We hold ourselves to high standards and will not be outworked. We take pride in having a deep sense of responsibility to ourselves, each other, our partners, and our customers. coatesgroup-coatesgroup:lever:faae2f61-6.title: Industrial Designer
coatesgroup-coatesgroup:lever:faae2f61-6.description: Be Part of Our Next Chapter For over almost 60 years, our solutions have enabled impactful connections between some of the world’s leading brands and their customers. And while we’ve already done a lot of work we’re proud of, we’re just getting started! We’re a global technology company focused on creating dynamic, smart, personalised and engaging customer experiences powered by our range of digital hardware, our proprietary content management system and our industry leading signage solutions. (For example: If you’ve ordered in-store or in the drive-thru at McDonald’s somewhere in the world in the last few years, chances are you’ve interacted with our digital solutions.) We work in over 50 global markets and have 9 offices around the world, with a global headquarters proudly located in our founding home of Sydney, Australia. Coates Group has the values of a family-owned business and the innovative spirit of a start-up, both which fuel our purpose – Creating Connections. Empowering Partnerships. Always Evolving. Through hard work, dedication and creativity, we’ve become industry leaders who have won awards and set records while remaining focused on continual growth and evolution. We are a 2x Australia Good Design Award winner and successfully completed the largest hardware deployment in Quick Service Restaurant history. We are curious, charismatic, authentic and we value and leverage the diversity of our crew. We are imaginers, kindness enthusiasts, experts, creators, thinkers, challengers, collaborators and over-achievers. And together, as a Crew, we are revolutionizing the way the world’s leading brands leverage technology to drive the best customer experiences. The Industrial Designer is responsible for the planning, design, and documentation of new and existing products, ensuring solutions are functional, user-friendly, and aligned to brand, technology, and commercial requirements. The role focuses on concept development, usability, and manufacturability, supporting the delivery of products that meet quality, aesthetic, and production standards across the product lifecycle.
responsibilities: Design Development & Delivery - Deliver high-quality design outputs that meet technical requirements, timelines, and defined success criteria, supporting the successful development of new and existing products across the product lifecycle.
Translate technical briefs into practical design solutions that meet functional and performance requirements
Plan and prioritise design tasks to support delivery of agreed milestones and project outcomes
Produce design outputs that balance usability, aesthetics, manufacturability, and commercial considerations
Ensure design work is completed accurately and meets defined quality and performance expectations

Design Ideation, Documentation & Communication - Translate design briefs into clear, structured outputs that communicate intent effectively and support alignment across design, engineering, and manufacturing stakeholders.
Develop artefacts that clearly convey design ideas and functionality
Prepare accurate technical drawings and specifications to support manufacturing and production
Present design concepts and prototypes in a clear and structured manner to support feedback and decision-making
Incorporate user insights and feedback into design iterations to strengthen usability and product outcomes
Manufacturing & Product Realisation - Apply practical understanding of materials and manufacturing processes to ensure design solutions are feasible, efficient, and ready to progress into production.
Apply Design for Manufacture (DFM) and Design for Excellence (DFX) principles during design development
Build and test prototypes or samples to validate product functionality, usability, and performance
Assess design feasibility by considering materials, production methods, safety requirements, and operational constraints
Refine designs to support smooth transition from concept through to production readiness

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement - Work collaboratively with cross-functional stakeholders and contribute to the continuous improvement of design practices, team capability, and product outcomes.
Engage proactively with product, engineering, marketing, and New Product Introduction (NPI) stakeholders to maintain alignment and progress
Communicate updates, risks, and design considerations clearly to support effective project delivery
Share knowledge and contribute ideas through team forums
Provide guidance and informal support to junior team members to strengthen team capability
qualifications: Bachelors degree in Industrial Design, Product Design, Mechanical Engineering, or related field​
3+ years experience in industrial design or product development roles​
Experience in product design creation, metalwork, basic electrical knowledge, DFM, technical drawing, BOM & costing
Experience delivering manufacturing ready outputs, including CAD, drawings, and documentation​
2D visualisation and graphic communication tools such as Adobe suite/ Figma/ Canva et

firebirdmusic-firebirdmusic:ashbyhq:c8bc.description: ABOUT THE ROLE This newly created role is responsible for building out Firebird Label Services' synchronization licensing offering from the ground up. In addition to directly pitching and securing sync opportunities on behalf of our repertoire, this position will establish sync processes and systems across our recorded music ecosystem — overseeing all efforts from initial pitch to final contract execution, and serving as a key liaison between our internal finance and legal teams and external partners. This position will coordinate the creative teams across each of our recorded music partners, along with their internal and/or third-party sync solutions, playing a critical role in ensuring the efficient and legally sound execution of synchronization licenses and invoice issuance for Firebird's new releases and catalog. Monitor product releases and identify any potential issues, coordinating troubleshooting and communication efforts. - Cross-functional Collaboration & Communication: Serve as a liaison between product management, engineering, and other areas to facilitate seamless communication and project execution. Support product teams with resource allocation, project scheduling, and coordination of key deliverables. Collaborate with product management to gather, prioritize, and share customer feedback. - Tool Management & Documentation: Implement and maintain tools and systems that enhance product operations, including project management software, data platforms, and feedback management tools. Maintain up-to-date documentation of product processes, requirements, workflows, and best practices for reference and training purposes. In our venture studio, you will have the unique opportunity to help define, and build new ventures from scratch, in sectors ranging from finance to healthcare, with the support and backing of the largest corporate partners in the world. Our vision is to build a body of knowledge that will become the global blueprint for how to build the leading technology businesses of the future. We are looking for someone who shares that ambition and has the passion and expertise to achieve it. 💪 YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES As a Venture Studio Tech Lead, you will work across both our Studio and Accelerator as a technical expert, turning new ideas into tangible outcomes and helping founders build AI capability into the core of their products and operations - not as a bolt-on feature. To be successful in this role, you should have previous experience leading teams to build secure, resilient and scalable tech and data science solutions. jobgether-jobgether:lever:a8272f07-50bb-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Business Analyst – Data Sensitivity & VDI Migration based in Brazil. This role offers the opportunity to shape enterprise-wide strategies for secure data storage, access, classification, and usage. You’ll analyze how systems, tools, endpoints, and business groups handle sensitive information across a complex technology environment. Your work will help identify high-risk data practices and determine where VDI or other secure access and storage approaches can deliver the greatest value. You’ll bridge business, security, and technology teams by translating complex findings into practical recommendations and migration priorities. The position combines business analysis, data governance, security assessment, stakeholder engagement, and technology strategy. You’ll contribute to business cases, migration roadmaps, compliance processes, and executive-level decision-making. It’s an ideal opportunity for an experienced Business Analyst who enjoys solving complex data security challenges and influencing enterprise transformation. Partner with business groups across the organization to inventory systems, tools, endpoints, and data usage patterns associated with physical device storage. Assess and classify data sensitivity across business groups, systems, processes, and workflows. Identify critical systems and high-risk data storage practices that should be prioritized for migration to VDI or other secure solutions. Document current-state and proposed future-state models for data storage, access, and usage. Evaluate viable approaches, including VDI, enhanced access controls, and other secure data management solutions, and recommend the most appropriate option for each use case. Develop business cases and recommendations for VDI migration, considering security risks, costs, operational impact, adoption, and business requirements. Analyze and document data and process flows across systems, servers, networks, and endpoints to support risk assessments and migration planning. Facilitate stakeholder interviews, workshops, requirements sessions, and discovery activities across multiple departments. Collaborate with Security, Technology, and Business teams to validate findings and ensure recommendations align with established data policies. Present analysis, findings, recommendations, and business cases to technology leadership and other key stakeholders. Support the development of a structured migration roadmap, including dependencies, priorities, risks, and change management considerations. Analyze and help design privileged access management processes and frameworks as part of broader data security initiatives. Support the development of auditing and compliance review processes covering data usage, access controls, and end-to-end data security. Translate complex technical and security findings into clear, actionable recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field. 5–7 years of professional Business Analyst experience, including work involving data governance, data classification or sensitivity assessments, IT infrastructure, endpoint environments, or related initiatives. Proven experience analyzing system usage and data flows across multiple business units, departments, or complex enterprise environments. Strong understanding of secure data storage, data access, classification, governance, and risk assessment principles. Familiarity with VDI concepts and platforms such as Citrix, VMware Horizon, or Azure Virtual Desktop, or demonstrated ability to quickly learn new technical domains. jobgether-jobgether:lever:c69161a2-5692-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director of Culinary Operations & Food Systems based in Canada. This is a senior culinary leadership role focused on building the systems that make food quality, safety, and consistency scalable across multiple locations. You will assess culinary operations, identify urgent product and quality issues, and establish practical standards that can withstand growth and team turnover. The role combines culinary expertise with operational discipline, covering recipes, specifications, food safety, menu performance, training, suppliers, and food economics. Rather than managing daily kitchen execution, you will provide remote leadership through on-site culinary leaders and location teams. You will use data and modern technology to diagnose problems, improve processes, and make informed decisions about products and menus. Success will require balancing exacting culinary standards with commercial realities such as food cost, waste, labor, and margin. This is an opportunity to build durable culinary infrastructure and develop leaders across a distributed operation. Recruit, train, coach, and develop culinary leaders across multiple locations, creating consistent standards and strengthening leadership capabilities remotely. Establish systems that allow culinary quality to remain consistent despite team turnover, geographic distance, and operational growth. Own the culinary drivers of food cost, yield, waste, labor efficiency, and margin, identifying opportunities to improve commercial performance without compromising quality. Use AI, data, and other technology tools to support culinary analysis, operational decision-making, documentation, training, and continuous improvement. Partner with on-site culinary leadership to translate strategic standards into practical execution and ensure accountability across locations. Demonstrated ability to diagnose product and quality problems, restore consistency, and build repeatable culinary systems rather than relying solely on individual expertise. Experience leading and directing kitchen execution remotely through on-site culinary leaders and distributed teams. Strong understanding of food cost, yield management, waste reduction, labor economics, and the relationship between culinary decisions and profitability. Proven experience with food safety, quality assurance, traceability, and root-cause analysis. Strong practical knowledge of recipe development, food specifications, menu engineering, culinary standards, and process documentation. Advanced, practical use of AI and data tools to support culinary management, operational analysis, and decision-making.
